g.text: A full four-artifact bundle takes about 89 minutes of stage time and 2.6M input /276K output tokens per paper
Table 4: per-stage time and tokens, mean over 5 papers on claude-opus-4-8; each skill runs as an isolated subprocess

g.text: Input = distinct content tokens (fresh plus cache writes); Cache = cached-context re-reads, billedat about 10% of fresh input; Output = prorated generated tokens. Bars in the paper give eachstage's share of the pipeline total.

Paper2Poster and Paper2Video carry the largest generator subtotals: the measured-fill loop is Paper2Poster's longest stage; Paper2Video spends most of its time across deck construction, rendering and muxing, and QA.Paper2Blog is driven by its bilingual revision gate; Paper2Reel has the smallest subtotal.

Running the three generators in parallel reduces elapsed wall-clock time; each skill's one-time context load (reading the paper and its figures) is folded into its first stage. When the LaTeX source is available the pipelinecan read original figure files and captions instead of the PDF path.
